condition: Колоннада Лувра с востока. Литография почти фронтальна, фото снято с юго-востока в упор под острым углом: сходится только плоскость фасада на малой площади, перспектива сильно различается.

control_points_note: Eight points picked by Claude on gridded zooms: pediment apex and base corners, central arch apex, cornice corners of the end pavilion/colonnade junctions, right-pavilion window apex. Points lie on several depth planes (pavilions project), which is why leave-one-out error is large.

observations: Same east facade; pediment, central arch and end pavilions identified in both images.
Control points cover ~2 % of the sheet and are nearly collinear; the fit is only trustworthy as a small local patch.
Not an exact viewpoint match: do not present the warped photo as an overlay of the whole sheet.
